$comment: Single source of truth for the ATOMS-E* error catalog. Append-only; never renumber. Ranges: docs/conventions.md. docsUrl anchors are stable.

errors.title: Unclassifiable file under the Atoms path
errors.message: File {file} under the Atoms path is neither an Atom, Methods, AtomJob, Shared DTO, nor a migration.
errors.fix: Move non-Atoms code out of the Atoms path, or make the class extend the appropriate atoms/core base class.

errors.title: Framework symbol referenced inside Atom code
errors.message: {symbol} belongs to a web framework and cannot be used inside Atom code — the Atoms runtime has no framework loaded.
errors.fix: Move the behavior into a Methods class (runs in your app via $this->app()) or use the atoms/core equivalent.

errors.title: Global framework helper called inside Atom code
errors.message: The helper {symbol}() does not exist in the Atoms runtime.
errors.fix: Use $this->config() for configuration, new \DateTimeImmutable() for time, or move the call into a Methods class.

errors.title: Monolith class referenced inside Atom code
errors.message: Reference to monolith class {symbol} inside Atom code. Atom code ships to the platform; your application's classes do not.
errors.fix: Pass data across the boundary as a Shared DTO (implement Atoms\Serialization\Payload) or call it via $this->app().

errors.title: Package not declared in atoms-composer.json
errors.message: Atom code references {symbol} from package {package}, which is not listed in atoms-composer.json.
errors.fix: Add the package to atoms-composer.json if it is on the approved list; otherwise remove the dependency.

errors.title: Facade used inside Atom code
errors.message: Facade {symbol} cannot be used inside Atom code — there is no service container in the Atoms runtime.
errors.fix: Move the behavior into a Methods class and call it via $this->app().

errors.title: Shared class references a non-core symbol
errors.message: Shared class {class} references {symbol}. Shared code runs in both worlds and may only use atoms/core and the PHP stdlib.
errors.fix: Keep Shared classes pure data: promoted scalar/Payload properties, accessors and factories only.

errors.title: Shared class contains behavior
errors.message: Shared class {class} method {method} looks like behavior (I/O or side effects), not data.
errors.fix: Shared classes are DTOs. Move behavior to the Atom (World A) or a Methods class (World B).

errors.title: env() called inside Atom code
errors.message: Atoms cannot read your application's .env.
errors.fix: Use `atoms secrets set KEY --env <environment>` and read it with $this->config('KEY').

errors.title: Native PHP serialization at a boundary
errors.message: serialize()/unserialize() must not appear in Atom, Shared, or boundary code.
errors.fix: Boundary values cross as JSON through the Atoms serializer; implement Atoms\Serialization\Payload for structured data.

errors.title: PHP extension not available in the runtime image
errors.message: Atom code uses extension {extension}, which the Atoms runtime image does not provide.
errors.fix: Check the supported extension list in the docs, or move the dependent code into a Methods class.

errors.title: Boundary type outside the serialization algebra
errors.message: {location} uses type {type}, which cannot cross the Atoms boundary.
errors.fix: Allowed: scalars, null, arrays of allowed types, Payload DTOs, DateTimeImmutable, backed enums.

errors.title: ORM object crossing the boundary
errors.message: {type} is an ORM object (Eloquent model / Doctrine entity) and cannot cross the Atoms boundary.
errors.fix: Pass a Shared DTO instead, e.g. PlayerSnapshot::fromUser($user) or $user->only([...]).

errors.title: Unserializable value in a boundary payload
errors.message: A {type} cannot cross the Atoms boundary.
errors.fix: Closures, resources, and container-bound objects cannot be serialized. Pass plain data or a Payload DTO.

errors.title: Payload class is not hydratable
errors.message: Payload class {class} must declare all state as promoted constructor properties with allowed types.
errors.fix: Use public readonly promoted constructor properties; remove non-promoted state.

errors.title: Value does not match the declared boundary type
errors.message: Cannot denormalize {value} into {type} at {location}.
errors.fix: The wire value and the declared PHP type disagree — check the manifest for version skew (atoms diff).

errors.title: Unknown Methods method called from an Atom
errors.message: {atom} calls $this->app()->{method}(), but {methodsClass} has no public method {method}.
errors.fix: Add the method to the Methods class, or fix the call — method names are checked statically against the manifest.

errors.title: Methods call-site signature mismatch
errors.message: {atom} calls {methodsClass}::{method}() with arguments that do not match its signature.
errors.fix: Update the call site or the Methods signature; both sides are part of the deployed contract.

errors.title: AtomJob constructor signature mismatch
errors.message: {atom} dispatches new {job}(...) with arguments that do not match its constructor.
errors.fix: AtomJob constructor parameters are the dispatch contract — keep promoted properties and the dispatch site in sync.

errors.title: Dispatched class is not an AtomJob
errors.message: {atom} dispatches {class}, which does not extend Atoms\AtomJob.
errors.fix: Extend Atoms\AtomJob, or run the code inline in the Atom instead of dispatching it.

errors.title: Manifest hash mismatch (version skew)
errors.message: The monolith was built against manifest {local} but the platform is serving {deployed}.
errors.fix: Deploy order matters: additive Atom changes deploy Atoms-first; contractions deploy monolith-first. Run `atoms diff`.

errors.title: Method not in deployed version
errors.message: Method {method} on {type} does not exist in the currently deployed manifest ({version}).
errors.fix: The monolith is ahead of the Atom deploy. Deploy Atoms first for additive changes (`atoms deploy`), then the monolith.

errors.title: Bundle rejected by platform validation
errors.message: The platform build service rejected the bundle: {reason}.
errors.fix: Run `atoms validate` locally — it applies the same checks and must reproduce the failure.

errors.title: atoms/core version outside the runtime's supported range
errors.message: Bundle was built against atoms/core {built}, but the platform runtime supports {supported}.
errors.fix: composer update atoms/core to a supported version and rebuild.

errors.title: Shipped migration was edited
errors.message: Migration {file} differs from the version recorded in the deployed manifest.
errors.fix: Migrations are append-only once shipped. Restore the original file and add a new migration instead.

errors.title: Migration numbering conflict
errors.message: Migrations for {type} have a duplicate or non-increasing version at {file}.
errors.fix: Number migrations with strictly increasing NNN_ prefixes (001_, 002_, ...).

errors.title: Migration likely exceeds the activation budget
errors.message: Migration {file} looks heavier than the activation-time budget ({budget_ms}ms).
errors.fix: Migrations run at Atom activation. Keep them tiny, or restructure as lazy per-row upgrades in Atom code.

errors.title: Migration failed at activation
errors.message: Migration {version} for {type}/{id} failed: {reason}.
errors.fix: The Atom stays deactivated. Fix the migration by appending a corrective one — never edit the failed file — and redeploy.

errors.title: Atom type not deployed
errors.message: Atom type {type} is not present in the customer's current deploy manifest.
errors.fix: Deploy the Atom (`atoms deploy`) or check the class basename — types are matched by basename.

errors.title: Turn deadline exceeded
errors.message: The Atom's turn exceeded the configured deadline.
errors.fix: Turns must stay short. Move slow work to an AtomJob via $this->dispatch(), and check for accidental blocking I/O.

errors.title: Capacity refused / rate limited
errors.message: The platform refused the request: {reason}. Retryable after backoff.
errors.fix: The SDK retries automatically where safe. Persistent refusals mean the fleet is at capacity — check the dashboard.

errors.title: Remote Atom exception
errors.message: {class} thrown inside {type}/{id}::{method}: {message}
errors.fix: This is your Atom code throwing. The sanitized remote trace is attached to the exception.

errors.title: Callback signature verification failed
errors.message: Rejected a platform callback: bad or missing Ed25519 signature.
errors.fix: Check the configured platform public key. If keys were rotated, update config and retry.

errors.title: Callback replay detected
errors.message: Rejected a platform callback: stale timestamp or reused nonce.
errors.fix: Usually clock skew (>300s) on the app host, or a genuine replay. Sync clocks; investigate repeated nonces.

errors.title: No Methods class for callback target
errors.message: A callback targeted {atomType}, but no Methods class resolves for it.
errors.fix: Create {expectedClass} (or mark a class with #[MethodsFor({atomType}::class)]).

errors.title: atoms.json missing or invalid
errors.message: Could not read atoms.json at the repository root: {reason}.
errors.fix: Run `atoms init` to create it, or fix the reported JSON error.

errors.title: atoms-composer.json invalid or package not allowed
errors.message: {reason}
errors.fix: atoms-composer.json may only contain `require` (from the approved package list) and `repositories`.

errors.title: Deploy credentials missing
errors.message: No Cloudflare API token found for environment {environment}.
errors.fix: Set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (or pass --api-token). In CI, supply it to the deploy action as `cloudflare-api-token`.

errors.title: Wrangler not found
errors.message: Could not find a Wrangler executable for environment {environment}: {reason}.
errors.fix: Run `npm install` in the Worker directory so node_modules/.bin/wrangler exists, or set ATOMS_WRANGLER_BIN to an absolute path. Atoms never downloads Wrangler for you.

errors.title: Wrangler command failed
errors.message: `wrangler {command}` exited with status {status}.
errors.fix: Read Wrangler's own output above; it reports Cloudflare API rejections verbatim. Check that the API token has Workers Scripts:Edit on the target account.

errors.title: Cloudflare account not configured
errors.message: Environment {environment} has no Cloudflare account id.
errors.fix: Add "account_id" to that environment in atoms.json, or set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. Find it on the Workers & Pages overview in the Cloudflare dashboard.

errors.title: Worker directory missing or incomplete
errors.message: The Atoms Worker project for environment {environment} is not usable: {reason}.
errors.fix: Point "worker_dir" in atoms.json at a checkout of the Atoms Cloudflare Worker (cloudflare/worker), and run `npm ci` inside it.
